changelog:
[0.5.5] - 2026-04-15

Added

  • Submissions dashboard now aggregates data from a second Google Drive folder for broader team coverage

[0.5.4] - 2026-03-24

Added

  • Submission dashboard now recursively scans nested subfolders within each contributor folder
  • Collapsible subfolder breakdown showing per-subfolder duration, clips, and size under each contributor
  • Direct Google Drive links on contributor and subfolder rows to open folders in browser

Fixed

  • Refresh button now spins correctly instead of showing full-page loading spinner

[0.5.3] - 2026-03-06

Fixed

  • Device view showing "Imported" instead of "Uploaded" for files that were both local and on Drive; "Uploaded" now takes priority as the more advanced state

[0.5.2] - 2026-03-06

Changed

  • Sidebar submission summary is now a single clickable area with hover highlight instead of nested buttons

Fixed

  • Device view incorrectly showing "New" badge for files already uploaded to Google Drive when the local copy was deleted

[0.5.1] - 2026-03-04

Added

  • Team Submissions dashboard: tracks total recording hours across all contributors by scraping video duration metadata from the shared Google Drive Submissions folder
  • Dedicated submissions page with metric cards (total hours, clips, contributors, size) and a full contributor leaderboard with gold/silver/bronze ranking
  • Compact submission summary in the sidebar footer, clickable to open the detail page
  • "Open in Drive" button to jump directly to the shared Submissions folder

Changed

  • Library view now sorts files by date from most recent to oldest
  • Google Drive OAuth now requests drive.readonly scope alongside drive.file for read access to shared folders (one-time re-auth required)

Fixed

  • Release page missing version headings for versions with screenshots (bash $1 expansion in inline node script)
  • Release page was stripping [Unreleased] changelog entries instead of publishing them under the current version

[0.5.0] - 2026-03-02

Added

  • Pipeline progress survives device disconnect: upload-to-Drive progress is now visible in the Library view after camera disconnection, with cancel support
  • Auto-navigate to Library when a device disconnects while viewing it, so users are never stuck on a dead device view
  • Auto-focus window on device connect: app comes to the front automatically when a camera is plugged in, with a dock bounce on macOS
  • "New" badge on unimported device files: files not yet in the library are highlighted with an amber "New" badge and subtle row tint so users can quickly see what needs importing
  • emptyVolumeTrashes() utility to reclaim disk space on external volumes after file deletion (macOS moves deleted files to .Trashes instead of unlinking)
  • CI cleanup job to delete old build-mac artifacts (keep latest 2) with 7-day retention
  • App screenshots on release page, placed under the matching changelog version section
  • CI skips macOS build for docs-only changes, reusing the latest cached artifact

Changed

  • Device detection now checks for DCIM root directory instead of the full media subfolder path, so empty/new devices are still recognized

Fixed

  • Docker e2e sandbox: add .dockerignore to prevent host node_modules from overwriting Linux dependencies, add missing xauth package and device-insta360 manifest, fix xvfb-run argument parsing

[0.4.6] - 2026-02-13

Added

  • Streaming import+upload pipeline: single-click "Import & Upload" button copies files from device and uploads to Google Drive concurrently
  • Per-file pipeline progress panel showing multi-stage status (queued, importing, uploading, done)
  • "Select New" button in device view to quickly select files not yet imported
  • Crash-safe pipeline journal with automatic recovery on app restart
  • AsyncChannel producer-consumer primitive for concurrent worker coordination
  • GDriveService.uploadSingleFile() for per-file streaming uploads
  • gdrive-is-ready IPC handler for Drive readiness checks

Changed

  • Redesigned pipeline progress panel: two-line file rows with full-width segmented progress bar replacing inline badge pills
  • Pipeline progress header now includes contextual icon (cloud-upload or hard-drive-download)
  • Use kernel-level fs.copyFile (macOS copyfile(3)) for file imports instead of userland streams — significantly faster transfer speeds
  • Progress reporting now polls destination file size every 250ms instead of per-chunk IPC, reducing renderer overhead from ~4,000 to ~160 messages per 16 GB file
  • Reorder device action buttons to prioritize "Import & Upload" over "Copy to Computer"
  • Pipeline file status badges now shown in device file table (uploading, uploaded, done)
  • Importing section shows safe-disconnect hint while imports are in progress

Fixed

  • Crash in DeviceView when queuedFiles field is missing from operation progress event
  • E2E tests: corrected stale locators for sidebar storage, drive status, and action buttons
  • Eliminated redundant stat() call on source file after copy completion

[0.4.5] - 2026-02-12

Changed

  • Progress panel redesign: show byte-level progress with transfer speed and ETA for imports and uploads
  • DeviceView and FileTable improvements

Removed

  • Remove "Delete Selected" button from Library view (redundant with "Delete Local")
  • Remove file verification state (verified status) from the entire stack: shared types, core library, IPC handlers, and UI

[0.4.4] - 2026-02-12

Changed

  • Redesign sidebar with proper section hierarchy: Library and Devices now both have consistent uppercase section headers
  • Rename sidebar nav item from "Library" to "All Videos" for clarity
  • Remove camera icon from sidebar header
  • Middle-truncate filenames in file tables to always show file extensions (.MP4, .JPEG, etc.)

[0.4.3] - 2026-02-12

Changed

  • Add standard macOS transparent padding to app icon for proper dock sizing
  • Rename default library folder from "DJI Media Manager" to "Media Manager"
  • Rename public downloads repo from dji-downloads to media-manager-releases

[0.4.2] - 2026-02-12

Added

  • "How it works" section on the download page explaining the local-first import workflow

Changed

  • Update download page icon to use the cropped app icon

[0.4.1] - 2026-02-12

Changed

  • Crop app icon to remove transparent background padding

[0.4.0] - 2026-02-12

Added

  • User-configurable Google Drive upload folder: paste a Drive folder URL in the Library view instead of a hardcoded destination
  • Google Drive account disconnect/reconnect: switch accounts without restarting the app
  • Google Drive backup section on the release download page with setup instructions

Fixed

  • Fix Insta360 adapter crash on launch: add missing device-insta360 to electron-vite bundle config
  • Add default export condition to all workspace packages for CJS compatibility

[0.3.0] - 2026-02-12

Added

  • In-place auto-update: download, extract, and replace the app without leaving the window
  • Insta360 device support: import videos and photos from Insta360 camera SD cards
  • App icon

Changed

  • Update dialog redesign with download progress and Install & Restart flow
  • DJI adapter: expanded device configuration and file parsing

[0.2.0] - 2026-02-12

Added

  • In-app update checker: auto-detects new releases and shows changelog with download link
  • Version display in sidebar footer; click to check for updates manually
  • CI publishes latest.json alongside the release page for update detection

Fixed

  • Fix Google Drive upload failing in release builds with "no redirect URI found" (credentials.json was empty)

Changed

  • Simplify release download page; extract inline HTML into docs/release/index.html template
  • Pre-commit guard requiring CHANGELOG.md updates when apps/ or packages/ change

[0.1.0] - 2026-02-11

Added

  • Initial release of Media Manager desktop app
  • DJI Osmo Nano device support: import videos and photos from camera SD card
  • Library view for browsing imported media
  • Video playback with proxy support (.LRF)
  • Optional Google Drive upload (OAuth2)
